name: Wizard OS 0.3.80 — 0.3.79 with the first-run Welcome (Wizard UX 2e316e77 -> fe269416), App Manager 79272034 -> c52f260f, Claude 0.2.10 and ChatGPT 0.2.8
about: Latest 0.3.79 plus: wizard-ux #733 (feature, Miguel-approved): the first run is one Welcome modal: connect AI (Claude recommended, ChatGPT, Tinfoil), pick a colour, say hello; the same on every install method. wizard-app-manager #333 Recommended fix: wam picks up the docker group when the user manager predates it (Store installs on prepared boxes); App Manager main also brings #321 (fix), #323 and #328 (Connections features) and #331 (fix). claude-connection #8 / chatgpt-connection #8 (wizard-app-store #42): sign in first, no nickname field, ?connect=1 opens straight into sign-in. Feature release: Latest (early access) first, Stable after the 72h soak.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

wizard-app-manager.note: Official main at c52f260f (merge of #334): 79272034 plus #321 (fix: app updates fill new settings first), #323 and #328 (Connections), #331 (fix: restore dialog buttons) and #333 (fix: docker group when the user manager predates it), and the 0.3.75–0.3.79 mirrors.

wizard-troubleshooter.note: Host tooling, no image: installed by `wam troubleshooter` as user systemd units (wizard-troubleshooter.service + wizard-guardian.timer, report-only) from exactly this commit; c1b4c43 plus #14 (an expired AI sign-in gets one step-by-step reconnect path), #16 (past repair chats are kept), #17 (background reply probes off unless the owner opts in), #18 (Tinfoil check no longer sends an empty tools list), #20 (James's one-tap screen, following the selected skin), #21 (one-sentence status line and recent chats), #22 (Check again; the page CSP allows the shell's same-origin kit and skin stylesheets), #23 (page classes are ts- prefixed so skin stylesheets cannot restyle it).

wizard-agent-service.note: Official main at 24f3cd0a (release train): carries humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#155 Recommended fix: owner CLI importer includes python-dotenv; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#183 Recommended fix: threads know MEDIA sends PDFs and other files up to 256 MB; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#197 Recommended fix: import older Hermes homes without shared-file or credential leaks; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#228 Recommended fix: let open owner asks stay Ready during background work; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#235 Recommended fix: chat pictures and files stay in the owner's browser, and edited files sti; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#241 Recommended fix: a sent file is a snapshot, so a later rewrite never changes earlier chat ; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#245 Recommended fix: pointer skills send the agent through the app's own skill, with end-to-en; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#250 Recommended fix: app workflow changes stay in released apps; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#254 Recommended fix: a chat is in one Space at a time; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#256 Recommended fix: Secret scan passes again (the round-10 synthetic placeholder is not a key; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#257 Recommended fix: the app-skill guard stops blocking reads and verification of installed sk; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#260 Recommended fix: scheduled notifications use the job's own agent and survive late admissio; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#263 Recommended fix: Markdown support is a fact, not a formatting push; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#264 Recommended fix: Secret scan passes again (shared-vault staging test's placeholder PEM is ; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#266 Recommended fix: a finished run leaves Working at once

wizard-ux.note: Official main at fe269416 (merge of #733, first-run Welcome) on top of 0.3.79’s 2e316e77.
